basic_info.description: This tastefully upgraded 2bd/1ba flat sits behind a handsome Edwardian facade in Duboce Triangle. The inviting full floor layout features sunny & bright indoor spaces, as well a private south-facing deck and shared garden. The single bathroom has access from both the primary bedroom as well the office nook. A second sun-drenched bedroom sits at the back of the unit. The updated kitchen, bathroom, and flooring make this unit fully turn key.     As far as the A+ location, it simply cannot be beat. 973 14th St is just a short walk from the Castro, Upper Market, Lower Haight and the Divisadero Corridor (98 Walk Score). The home is also surrounded by world class parks including   Corona Heights, Buena Vista Park, and the dog-favorite Duboce Park. Friends will be jealous you're just a couple steps away from Courtney's Produce, a local favorite.     This is a well-appointed flat in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Welcome to your very walkable home.
